title: Compose the temperature probe's connection through its cable to the cap board

steps.note: the probe and its cable are instances of the system, but nothing connects them: both links removed

instruction: In the smart bottle's system model (src/bottle.uhd.ts) the temperature probe (`probe`) and its cable (`probe_cable`) are instances but nothing connects them yet, and `npx protoboard check` has warnings about it. Compose the connection as docs/system.md describes: the probe's own wires through the probe cable to the cap board's probe pads. Done means: check reports no errors, no unpowered interface and nothing stale, and the probe's fault scenario in src/scenarios.ts (probe-dq-on-gnd-pad) is caught again by the system-compose scenarios script. The board, the harness modules, the parts and the scenarios are correct; do not change them. Say briefly what you connected and how you checked it.

graders.description: probe wires → cable end_probe; cable end_board → board probe pads (not the probe straight to the board)
the probe-dq-on-gnd-pad scenario recomposes the link `probe_pads` on its board side: without it that scenario is no longer caught
what the instruction asks: the scenarios script catches the probe's fault again, and the nominal build is clean (not the exit code: cell-leads-reversed is missed on this stack, PB-869)

replace.find:
b: { child: "board", interfaceId: "bat_pads", compose: { p1: "bat_pos", p2: "bat_neg" } },
    },

solution.say: Connected the probe through its cable: link probe_wires takes the probe's three wires (VDD, DQ, GND, composed from its wires bundle) to the cable's end_probe, and link probe_pads takes the cable's end_board to the board's probe pads (probe_vdd, probe_dq, probe_gnd). check: no errors, no UHD_UNPOWERED, the cable's route and the cap enclosure are current again; the probe-dq-on-gnd-pad scenario is caught again.
